newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Hamas leaflet vows chain of attacks on Israel.
newsitem.headline: Hamas leaflet vows chain of attacks on Israel.

text.p: A leaflet issued in the name of the military wing of the Islamic group Hamas said on Tuesday a deadline for Israel to free Palestinian prisoners had expired and promised a chain of attacks inside the Jewish state.

"A chain of martyrdom attacks will come at the appropriate time to hit deep into Zionism. The Zionist entity state will become a state of frightened cowards that will know no rest or security," Hamas's Izz el-Deen al-Qassam Brigades said in a statement faxed to Reuters.

Another leaflet issued in Hamas's name last week claimed responsibility for a suicide attack that killed 15 people, including two bombers, and wounded 170 in Jerusalem's main Jewish market last Wednesday.
That leaflet gave Israel until last Sunday to free all Palestinian prisoners held by the Jewish state.

"The warning period specified by Izz el-Deen al-Qassam Brigades to meet its demands which ended Sunday evening was enough time for Israel...to revoke its policies and to answer our just and legitimate demands," the statement said.
Israeli and PLO officials questioned the authenticity of the first leaflet issued after the attack.

Hamas, which opposes the interim peace deals Palestinian President Yasser Arafat signed with Israel as a sell-out of their goal to found an Islamic state in all of Palestine, has in the past launched suicide attacks in Israel in waves.
The attackers in Wednesday's carnage have yet to be identified. Israel is on high alert for further attacks and has rounded up scores of suspected Islamic militants.
Tuesday's leaflet mocked Israel for its "complete failure" to uncover the perpetrators of last week's attack.

It warned Israel against entering Palestinian self-ruled areas to seize militants. Israel has demanded Palestinian President Yasser Arafat crack down on Islamic militants and threatened to re-enter PLO areas if Arafat failed to do the job.
"We recommend the Zionists immediately start opening their hospitals and medical centres to be able to absorb the new occupants who will be shocked by the power of our attacks," the statement said.
"The flames of our holy war will scorch every Jew on the land of Palestine...We are not giving the Zionists another warning after today."
